consolidation_targets.name: Local Projection Stability
consolidation_targets.requirement: Repeated restricted Pi_A projection remains internally consistent within eligible local basins.

consolidation_targets.name: Admissibility Boundary Preservation
consolidation_targets.requirement: Restricted local boundaries remain intact throughout proof segment execution.

consolidation_targets.name: Failure Geometry Non-Collapse
consolidation_targets.requirement: Preserved blockers and excluded domains remain active after consolidation.

consolidation_targets.name: Counterexample Trace Integrity
consolidation_targets.requirement: All local stability claims remain traceable to counterexample lineage.

consolidation_targets.name: Restricted Composition Preservation
consolidation_targets.requirement: Local composition remains bounded and does not imply unresolved global closure.

consolidation_classes.meaning: Restricted local projection behavior remains stable under audited conditions.
